unresolvedConflicts.subject: Blackstone Energy Transition Partners V (BETP V) — strategy and North American qualification
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The Form D confirms vehicle identity and an active securities offering but does not state the fund's direct-equity infrastructure strategy or geographic mandate. The opened evidence also did not establish a BETP V-attributed current North American holding. Treating BETP V as the same strategy and geography as BETP IV would be an unsupported series-continuity inference.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Obtain a BETP V-specific Blackstone release, private-placement memorandum, institutional LP memorandum or other fund-specific primary material that states the investment strategy and geographic mandate. Include BETP V only after North America and direct-equity infrastructure scope are independently supported.
